limitations: PAPER TRADING ONLY. No broker order transport exists. No live money is connected.
No validated Forex edge or measured forward performance yet. No automatic promotion.
Planned stop risk is not a guaranteed maximum loss; gaps and slippage may exceed it.
Fees/slippage and conservative 10:1 maximum leverage are explicit experimental assumptions, not verified account terms.
Intraday-only policy: no new positions 21:55–01:00 UTC; missed rollover requires a known financing debit before valuation resumes.
Only observed quotes contribute to drawdown, MFE and MAE; missed intrabar extremes are unknown.
Calendar totals use UTC; historical research is not forward paper performance.
